title: Christian Doctrines
modules: Eschatology: Three Views On The Millennium
The Intiatory Rite Of The Church
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an event whereby a sinner turns away from sin and come to a believing (saving) knowledge of Christ."
Conversion is an event whereby a sinner turns away from sin and come to a believing (saving) knowledge of Christ.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an attempt to understand and justify God's love and holiness in the midst of human suffering."
Theodicy is an attempt to understand and justify God's love and holiness in the midst of human suffering.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the Christian reformed name for a Presbytery."
The Classis is the Christian reformed name for a Presbytery.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the word that is used to describe a body of acceptable teachings of the Bible."
Doctrine is the word that is used to describe a body of acceptable teachings of the Bible.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the originator of this construction of Trinity."
A Byzantine merchant by name Theodotus is the originator of this construction of Trinity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the dimension upon which some various conceptions and differences exist among Christian churches and traditions."
The extent of atonement is the dimension upon which some various conceptions and differences exist among Christian churches and traditions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the hypothetical necessity and consequent absolute necessity."
Two of these views are the hypothetical necessity and consequent absolute necessity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means by which fallen sinners are reconciled with God (Ekem, 2005 p. 2)."
Atonement denotes a means by which fallen sinners are reconciled with God (Ekem, 2005 p. 2).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the reason Christian theism affirms the existence of the God of the Bible."
The attributes are the reason Christian theism affirms the existence of the God of the Bible.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the things that mark a true church. 3.3 Discipline of Erring Members Paul insists that everything in the church must be done in orderly manner (I Cor. 14:40)."
Unity is one of the things that mark a true church. 3.3 Discipline of Erring Members Paul insists that everything in the church must be done in orderly manner (I Cor. 14:40).
